title: CHMP meeting highlights
description: One record per monthly CHMP meeting, parsed from EMA's 'Meeting highlights from the Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use (CHMP)' news page. Stored as one document per meeting; 'outcomes' is the per-medicine table if the DB is relational (meeting_id = id).

id.description: Primary key: the news page slug, e.g. 'meeting-highlights-committee-medicinal-products-human-use-chmp-20-23-july-2026'.

summary.description: Standfirst under the title, e.g. 'Twelve new medicines recommended for approval; ...'.

label.description: Dates as written in the title, e.g. '20-23 July 2026'.

highlights.description: The narrative at the top of the page, split at its headings. The only content on 2006-2009 pages.

statistics.description: The 'CHMP statistics: Text version' box (2024 onwards); null when the page only has the infographic.

breakdown.description: e.g. '9 new non-orphan medicines, 2 orphan medicines, and 1 biosimilar medicine'.

year_total.description: Cumulative total for the year so far.

outcomes.description: One entry per medicine in the page's structured cards/tables (2010 onwards). Empty for 2006-2009 pages, whose medicines are only in highlights[].medicines.

sections.description: Text and links under h2 sections that are not medicine cards or documents (e.g. 'CHMP statistics', 2009 'Referrals').

documents.description: Document cards on the page: PRIME eligibility, scientific advice, invented names, summaries of opinion, the PDF version of old highlights.

related_content.description: 'Related content' (or 2009 'Related press releases') links: news items, the meeting's event page, ...

related_medicines.description: The 'Related medicine information' list at the bottom of the page.

medicine_names.description: Every medicine named on the page (outcomes, narrative, related medicines), de-duplicated. Index this for asset-name lookups.

content_text.description: Whole page body as plain text, one line per paragraph; for full-text search.

medicines.description: Medicines named in this text (bold names or 'Name (inn)'); heuristic.

medicine_name.description: Trade name, e.g. 'Enhertu'; for reviews, the review name (e.g. 'Janus kinase (JAK) inhibitors').

section.description: Heading the medicine is listed under, verbatim.

re_examination.description: The section concerns a re-examination (start of, or opinion following one).

common_name.description: Used instead of an INN for some vaccines and biologicals.

company_role.description: Applicant for new medicines; marketing-authorisation holder for extensions/referrals.

orphan.description: true when the page marks it as an orphan medicine; null when not stated.

status.description: From the EMA link text, e.g. 'pending EC decision', 'Withdrawal', 'withdrawn application'.

ema_url.description: The medicine's EPAR / variation / referral page (or its summary of opinion on 2010-2017 pages).

extra.description: Any other label on the card, plus: orphan_note, procedure_number (e.g. 'II-29'), products (medicines a review covered), name_cell.
